{{Quote|You must not allow the clones to reach the surface.''"<br />"''Our new proton cannon are in the optimum position to prevent that, sir.|[[Emir]] [[Wat Tambor]] and [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]]|<ref name="IOR">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>}}
The '''J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon''' was a long-range self-propelled artillery unit used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
This heavy droid cannon could be operated by one [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] in a side-seat, or by pre-installed [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid brain/Legends|brain]]. It did not have an automatic reloading chamber, but instead was a single shot breach-loader. Shells had to be manually loaded by at least two battle droids into the breach before each shot. The shells used were powerful enough to breach the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ship]] or completely destroy a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i Gunship]] with a single hit.

The artillery piece, resembling a [[Flak gun/Legends|flak gun]], was mounted on top of four legs, similar to that of [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid|Advanced dwarf spider droids]], which allowed it to turn and re-position itself, however, its turning rate was quite slow, its legs being the only rotational device.

==History==
These units were used during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], where they fired upon the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] invasion force. Three cannons managed to take down a ship within seconds.

[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] ordered a retreat due to the damage the fleet was taking, as the cannon shells were able to penetrate the shields. During the liberation of the prisoners, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] took control of one of the cannons and destroyed all other cannons with help from [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] before having to abandon the cannon due to incoming fire from an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]].

The proton cannons would later be used by Geonosians during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] where they destroyed many [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT/c]] gunships.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', The J-1 is the cannon option when fighting on the CIS side in large battles, a counter to the Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7]].

The 7869 Battle for Geonosis was a [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set released in 2011. It featured a model of this cannon that could fire a missile, had movable legs, and adjustable elevation and depression. The set also came with a [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC Speeder]], [[Rex/Legends|Captain Rex]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] and two B1 battle droids.
